newsitem.title: USA: T R Financial declares 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: T R Financial declares 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: T R Financial Corp said on Tuesday that it declared a 2-for-1 stock split in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend to shareholders of record on May 1, 1997. The new shares will be distributed on May 14, 1997.
The number of shares outstanding will increase to 17,636,472 from 8,818,236 shares as of March 31, 1997.

The company said it increased its quarterly cash dividend to $0.13 per common share on the post-split shares from $0.11 per post-split share, to be paid on June 2, 1997 to shareholders of record on May 15, 1997.
